clips.title: The story
paras: In Brill, Apothecary Johaan works to develop a plague for the Forsaken. The Royal Apothecary Society and Lady Sylvanas have charged him with lethal experiments on local plants and animals.

Apothecary Johaan works openly from Brill in Tirisfal Glades for the newly formed Royal Apothecary Society. Like his colleagues across Lordaeron, he follows direct orders to create biological and alchemical weapons. The Forsaken hope these weapons will secure their fragile future against the living and the Scourge alike.
